note: Additive discovery output (WP008.1): ResourceModel help pages for model references missing from resource-models.json. Property tables become model definitions, 'Possible enumeration values' tables become enum definitions, everything else is reported as unresolved rather than guessed.

BudgetItem.name: BudgetItemPeriods
BudgetItem.description: This is a list of period Dates and there totals.

BudgetItemAccount.name: ReportingLevelType
BudgetItemAccount.description: Gets or sets the type of the reporting level Type.

BudgetItemAccount.name: Category
BudgetItemAccount.description: Gets or sets the Account category.

CommercialDocumentLine.name: SelectionId
CommercialDocumentLine.description: Gets or sets the selection identifier. This is the selected Item Id or Account Id.

CommercialDocumentLine.name: Quantity
CommercialDocumentLine.description: The Quantity of a LineType of Item. For a LineType of Accounts, a Quantity of 1 is required. Accounts with a quantity greater than one will result in a validation message.

CommercialDocumentLine.name: AnalysisCategoryId1
CommercialDocumentLine.description: Gets or sets the Analysis Category identifier. This needs to be a valid AnalysisCategoryId.

CommercialDocumentLine.name: AnalysisCategoryId2
CommercialDocumentLine.description: Gets or sets the Analysis Category identifier. This needs to be a valid AnalysisCategoryId.

CommercialDocumentLine.name: AnalysisCategoryId3
CommercialDocumentLine.description: Gets or sets the Analysis Category identifier. This needs to be a valid AnalysisCategoryId.

CommercialDocumentLine.name: UnitCost
CommercialDocumentLine.description: Gets the UnitCost identifier. This is the Unit Cost of the Item at Time of Sale (only available on TaxInvoices for Item Lines).

ItemBundleItem.name: Quantity
ItemBundleItem.description: Quantity that will be included in this bundle

ItemBundleItem.name: PriceListCostExclusive
ItemBundleItem.description: Price List Cost Exclusive of this item

ItemBundleItem.name: PriceListCostInclusive
ItemBundleItem.description: Price List Cost Inclusive of this item

RecurringJournalRecurrence.name: FrequencyType
RecurringJournalRecurrence.description: Gets or sets the type of the frequency type. OneTimeOnly = 1, Daily = 2, Weekly = 3, Monthly = 4, MonthlyRelative = 5, Yearly = 6, YearlyRelative = 7

RecurringJournalRecurrence.name: RecurrenceRangeType
RecurringJournalRecurrence.description: Gets or sets the type of the recurrence range. NoEndDate = 1, EndAfterOccurrences = 2, FixedEndDate = 3

RecurringJournalTransaction.name: Effect
RecurringJournalTransaction.description: Gets or sets the Journal Entry. Debit = 1, Credit = 2

RecurringJournalTransaction.name: AnalysisCategoryId1
RecurringJournalTransaction.description: Gets or sets the Analysis Category identifier. This needs to be a valid AnalysisCategoryId.

RecurringJournalTransaction.name: AnalysisCategoryId2
RecurringJournalTransaction.description: Gets or sets the Analysis Category identifier. This needs to be a valid AnalysisCategoryId.

RecurringJournalTransaction.name: AnalysisCategoryId3
RecurringJournalTransaction.description: Gets or sets the Analysis Category identifier. This needs to be a valid AnalysisCategoryId.

RecurringProfile.name: DueDateMethodId
RecurringProfile.description: Specifies which method should be used to determine the invoice due date. Days from date of Invoice = 0, Day of the current Month = 1, Day of the following Month = 2, End of the current Month = 3, Days from the end of the Invoice Month = 4

RecurringProfile.name: DueDateMethodValue
RecurringProfile.description: Based on DueDateMethodId selection number of days for invoice due date.

Schedule.name: ScheduleFrequencyId
Schedule.description: Gets or sets the schedule frequency id. Required. 1 = Every Day 2 = Every Week 4 = Every Second Week 5 = Every Month 6 = Every Second Month 7 = Every Third Month 8 = Every Sixth Month 9 = Every Year

TakeOnAccountGroup.name: TakeOnAccountBalances
TakeOnAccountGroup.type: Collection of Take On Account Balance

values.name: LockedGSTBadDebtRecovery
values.description: When a GST Bad Debt recovery is processed, part of the process relies on the Invoice Total Outstanding, this is controlled by the Receipt. We use this Status to indicate that documents cannot be deleted or unallocated as a Dad Debt recovery is using an invoice this receipt is linked to.

values.name: SingleProjectRate
values.description: Timesheet tasks will be consolidated into one invoice line

values.name: ProjectRatePerHour
values.description: This project will be billed using a project hourly rate.

values.name: StaffRatePerHour
values.description: This project will be billed using the relevant user rate for each task.

values.name: TaskRatePerHour
values.description: This project will be billed using the task rate.

values.name: TaskDetailed
values.description: Each timesheet task will appear as a separate invoice line item.

values.name: GroupByTask
values.description: Timesheet tasks will be grouped on an invoice line.

values.name: Consolidated
values.description: Consolidate all timesheet tasks into one invoice line per project.
